agent_explanation: High horizontal speed (~40.9 m/s) with large radius (~1.19) vs thin wall (w=0.1) causes substep distance per substep (~0.03s/22≈0.0007s *40 ≈0.029m) but combined with vertical motion and corner collision, positional correction/impulse fails to prevent penetration. Body moves from x≈12.10 (distance +0.268) at step 9 to x≈11.46 (penetration -0.388) at step 10, crossing through thin wall without sufficient collision resolution, indicating tunneling / missed CCD for fast body vs thin wall.
